PITAKA's story begins with a single thread of aramid fiber, a line that stands for constant self-reflection and reinvention. Inspired by that thread, we reimagined the PITAKA logo, turning its initials into an artistic monogram.
Lightweight yet durable aramid fibers are interlaced so the lettering is woven directly into the case, giving it a classic look and a refined texture that is a pleasure to touch.

A case under 1 mm thick shields the Camera Control button with aramid fiber, while a hidden capacitive layer lets you tap and slide effortlessly. It preserves the aramid texture for precise, responsive control.
A sleek, barely-there profile that preserves your phone's original feel. Ideal for minimalists who want elegant protection with no added weight.
